name: Self-Directed Queries Complexity / Littlestone Dimension
details: For a finite class on a domain of size $n$, $\mathrm{M}_{\mathrm{sd}}(\mathcal H)\geq\mathrm{L}(\mathcal H)/\log_2 n$.
proof: Theorem 7 of Ben-David--Kushilevitz--Mansour proves $\mathrm L(\mathcal H)\leq\mathrm M_{\mathrm{sd}}(\mathcal H)\log_2 n$ for a finite domain of size $n$.  Their tree proof takes a minimum-rank self-directed strategy tree and bounds its number of leaves by the binomial sum determined by its rank; the information-theoretic proof encodes a target by the at-most-$\mathrm M_{\mathrm{sd}}$ mistaken queried points.  Rearranging gives the displayed inequality.
